sectors.trend: AI trade roaring back; stocks extend winning run on AI boost. ASML/TSMC plot bigger AI chip canvas. Alibaba to roll out China's top AI chip. Amazon debuts UK bond sale to fund AI buildout. CrowdStrike/Palo Alto rally while chips fall in rotation.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle accelerating but showing internal rotation from chips to software/security. Apple entering AI inference market signals broadening adoption. Risk of overvaluation in pure-play AI names.

sectors.trend: Saudi boosts Hormuz exports and Yanbu supply. Diesel shortage to last into 2027. Oil tanker shortage threatens gas prices. Hormuz crisis pushing coal demand to record. California gas prices set to drop next month.
sectors.implications: Structural supply tightness in diesel/tankers creates inflationary pressure. Saudi flexibility mitigates near-term oil risk but coal substitution signals longer energy transition stress.

sectors.trend: VW warning fails to derail auto stock optimism. BofA recommends buying tumbling aviation shares. Boeing completes 13-satellite O3b constellation.
sectors.implications: Market digesting VW guidance without panic; auto sector showing resilience. Aviation recovery theme gaining momentum.

sectors.trend: Goldman sees APAC deals boom to 2027. JPMorgan on India payments. Amazon's UK bond sale prices bigger but demand cools. Axon prices $1B zero-coupon notes. Sabre prices $1.35B secured notes.
sectors.implications: M&A activity robust in APAC. Corporate debt issuance accelerating, signaling capital-intensive expansion. Cooling demand on tech bonds hints at tightening credit conditions.

sectors.trend: Copper 6th consecutive day up toward record on China tightness. China gold imports top 1,000 tons. Tron crypto ETF launches.
sectors.implications: China-driven demand for industrial metals and safe-haven gold signals both growth and hedging. Crypto ETF access broadens retail participation.

sectors.trend: Mumbai $74M record tower deal. Australia highest rates since GFC. Gold Coast Clooney estate sells. Lennar cuts delivery forecast. Bally's triggers going concern warning.
sectors.implications: Luxury real estate resilient globally but rate-sensitive markets (Australia, US) face headwinds. Consumer discretionary under pressure from fuel costs.

market_outlook.short_term: Stocks likely to extend gains on AI momentum and FTSE 100 strength, but volatility elevated from Fed hawkishness and oil supply fears. Expect rotation within tech (chips to security/infrastructure). Oil may spike on tanker/diesel shortage headlines. 10Y yield testing 5% caps multiple expansion.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact through 2027 per Goldman. Energy transition stress (coal record, diesel shortage) creates 2-3 year inflationary tailwind for energy names. APAC M&A and India payments offer multi-year growth. Geopolitical fragmentation (Canada-Asia, US-China stability) reshapes trade flows. Rate cycle likely peaks but stays elevated, pressuring duration-sensitive assets.
